concept.description: Identifies all architectural units and associates their Java types.
concept.cypher: MATCH (architecturalUnit:JMolecules:Architecture:ArchitecturalUnit)-[:CONTAINS]->(architecturalUnitType:Java:Type) RETURN architecturalUnit.id AS ArchitecturalUnit architecturalUnit.fqn AS ArchitecturalUnitType ORDER BY architecturalUnit.id, architecturalUnit.fqn
